definitions.short: to scatter words , i.e. prate (or hum)
definitions.full: H6527. parat [ מָּרַט ] verb very dubious, Qal Participle plural הַנָּ֑בֶל עַלמִּֿי הַמֹּרְטִים Amos 6:5 (Late Hebrew break off, divide , so Syriac ; Late Hebrew מְּרוּטָה , Aramaic מְּרִיטָא , small coin, change , hence) AW Ra AE Ki divide words into parts (in singing), AV chant ; and Thes scatter (compare מֶּרֶט ) empty words; possibly also would be stammer (of broken speech; said contemptuously): — (Arabic is precede, act hastily , IV. act extravagantly, talk immoderately (see further Dr Am. 236 ), hence) AW (as alternative) improvise carelessly, idly .
